champions.name: Aatrox
champions.title: Champion #1
champions.description: Aatrox is a Top lane champion.
strengths: Aatrox has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Is my ultimate available? Aatrox without R is half a champion. When R is up, look to extend trades and brawl — when it's down, play safe and farm. Always position to hit all three World Ender strikes for maximum damage.

champions.name: Ahri
champions.title: Champion #2
champions.description: Ahri is a Mid lane champion.
strengths: Ahri has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Are enemies grouped or isolated? Ahri excels at picking off single out-of-position targets with Charm into combo. If enemies are grouped and peeling for each other, wait for a flank opportunity rather than forcing a bad engage.

champions.name: Akali
champions.title: Champion #3
champions.description: Akali is a Mid lane champion.
strengths: Akali has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Is my target alone and are their summoners down? Akali is a pure assassin — never fight 2v1 without your ultimate. Use Twilight Shroud to bait out abilities, then re-engage when enemies waste cooldowns on the smoke.

champions.name: Akshan
champions.title: Champion #4
champions.description: Akshan is a Top lane champion.
strengths: Akshan has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Can I safely revive a dead ally with my passive? Track which enemies have the Scoundrel mark — killing them revives teammates which can flip the entire game. Prioritize targets that give revives over pure damage targets.

champions.name: Alistar
champions.title: Champion #5
champions.description: Alistar is a Support lane champion.
strengths: Alistar has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Is my ADC in a position to follow up my engage? Alistar's Pulverize and Headbutt combo is only as good as your team's follow-up. Never engage if your carry is out of range — you'll just burn your cooldowns for nothing.

champions.name: Ambessa
champions.title: Champion #6
champions.description: Ambessa is a Top lane champion.
strengths: Ambessa has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Which gap in the enemy team can I exploit? Ambessa thrives by diving isolated targets in the backline. Use your dash chain to close distance quickly but always have an escape path planned before you commit to a fight.

champions.name: Amumu
champions.title: Champion #7
champions.description: Amumu is a Jungle lane champion.
strengths: Amumu has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Are at least 3 enemies grouped together? Amumu's ultimate is a game-winning teamfight tool but wasted on one target. Wait for the perfect multi-person Curse of the Sad Mummy rather than using it reactively on a single enemy.

champions.name: Anivia
champions.title: Champion #8
champions.description: Anivia is a Mid lane champion.
strengths: Anivia has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Can I use my wall to split the enemy team? Crystallize is one of the most powerful zoning tools in the game. Use it to cut off escaping enemies, separate a carry from their team, or block enemy engage paths before a fight starts.

champions.name: Annie
champions.title: Champion #9
champions.description: Annie is a Mid lane champion.
strengths: Annie has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Do I have 4 stacks on my passive ready? Always track your Pyromania stacks — hitting 4 means your next ability stuns. Hold that stun for the highest-value target (usually the enemy carry) rather than wasting it on a minion or tank.

champions.name: Aphelios
champions.title: Champion #10
champions.description: Aphelios is a ADC lane champion.
strengths: Aphelios has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Which weapon combination do I have and what does it enable? Aphelios has 5 weapons with different power states. Learn which 2-gun combos are strongest (Infernum+Crescendum, Gravitum+Severum) and position your fights around having those weapons ready.

champions.name: Ashe
champions.title: Champion #11
champions.description: Ashe is a ADC lane champion.
strengths: Ashe has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Can my Enchanted Crystal Arrow start a fight from an unexpected angle? Hawkshot a bush before firing your ultimate blindly. The best Ashe ultimates come from unexpected angles — through walls or across the map to start a fight your team wasn't expecting.

champions.name: AurelionSol
champions.title: Champion #12
champions.description: AurelionSol is a Mid lane champion.
strengths: AurelionSol has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: How much stardust do I have and is my ultimate ready? Aurelion Sol is a scaling champion — the longer the game goes the more damage he deals. Focus on stardust stacking early, avoid risky fights before level 6, and look for roam opportunities once your ultimate is available.

champions.name: Aurora
champions.title: Champion #13
champions.description: Aurora is a Mid lane champion.
strengths: Aurora has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Is the enemy team spread out enough for me to pick someone off? Aurora excels at isolating and bursting single targets. Use your mobility to find flanking angles rather than fighting head-on — a good flank on a carry is worth more than trading with a tank.

champions.name: Azir
champions.title: Champion #14
champions.description: Azir is a Mid lane champion.
strengths: Azir has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Are my soldiers placed to control the space I need? Azir is about controlling zone with soldiers, not just dealing damage. Place soldiers to cut off escape routes before engaging — and always save your ultimate as an emergency peel tool if your carry gets dived.

champions.name: Bard
champions.title: Champion #15
champions.description: Bard is a Support lane champion.
strengths: Bard has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Will my Tempered Fate help or hurt my team right now? Cosmic Binding is powerful but Tempered Fate requires perfect timing. Never ult enemies who are already losing a fight to your team — only use it to cancel a dangerous enemy engage or save an ally from death.

champions.name: Bel'Veth
champions.title: Champion #16
champions.description: Bel'Veth is a Jungle lane champion.
strengths: Bel'Veth has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Have I fully cleared my jungle and built enough Void Coral stacks? Bel'Veth is a late-game monster that needs farm to reach her power spike. Prioritize full clears over early ganks, and use your passive attack speed to shred objectives faster than any other jungler.

champions.name: Blitzcrank
champions.title: Champion #17
champions.description: Blitzcrank is a Support lane champion.
strengths: Blitzcrank has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Is the enemy ADC or support out of position and hookable? One Rocket Grab on a carry can win the lane instantly. Never hook tanks or bruisers — always aim for the most vulnerable target. Use Power Fist knockup immediately after a grab for the full CC chain.

champions.name: Brand
champions.title: Champion #18
champions.description: Brand is a Mid lane champion.
strengths: Brand has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Are at least 2-3 enemies stacked for my ultimate to bounce between? Brand's passive Blaze stacks make his combos devastating but his ultimate is most powerful when enemies are grouped. Land Pillar of Flame to stun Blazed enemies and always start teamfights with your passive applied.

champions.name: Braum
champions.title: Champion #19
champions.description: Braum is a Support lane champion.
strengths: Braum has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Is my carry under threat right now? Braum is a pure peeler — your job is keeping your ADC alive, not making plays. Position your Unbreakable shield between your carry and the highest damage threat every fight. Never roam far from your ADC unless they are completely safe.

champions.name: Briar
champions.title: Champion #20
champions.description: Briar is a Jungle lane champion.
strengths: Briar has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Do I have enough health to safely brawl right now? Briar has no mana but her abilities cost health. Always enter fights above 50% health and use your healing passive to sustain during extended brawls. Avoid fighting multiple enemies at low HP since you can't retreat once you bloodlust.

champions.name: Caitlyn
champions.title: Champion #21
champions.description: Caitlyn is a ADC lane champion.
strengths: Caitlyn has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Am I using my range advantage to zone and not just poke? Caitlyn's 650 range is her biggest weapon. Place traps in bushes and at objectives to control space, then use your range to poke enemies who step on them. Never let the enemy close the gap — always keep max distance.

champions.name: Camille
champions.title: Champion #22
champions.description: Camille is a Top lane champion.
strengths: Camille has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Have I identified the one target I want to lock down with my ultimate? Camille's Hextech Ultimatum is a 1v1 tool — use it to isolate the enemy carry away from their team. Never use it on a tank or someone their team will immediately follow into your cage.

champions.name: Cassiopeia
champions.title: Champion #23
champions.description: Cassiopeia is a Mid lane champion.
strengths: Cassiopeia has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Is the enemy team facing toward me or away from me? Cassiopeia's ultimate Petrifying Gaze stuns enemies facing her but only slows enemies facing away. Always engage from behind or the side to guarantee the stun, and never fight without your poison applied first.

champions.name: Cho'Gath
champions.title: Champion #24
champions.description: Cho'Gath is a Top lane champion.
strengths: Cho'Gath has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Can I use Feast to secure this objective or execute this carry? Cho'Gath's true damage ultimate has no cooldown concern in the late game. Use it to steal Baron and Dragon with true damage, not just on champions. Every stack from Feast makes you permanently tankier so never waste it.

champions.name: Corki
champions.title: Champion #25
champions.description: Corki is a Mid lane champion.
strengths: Corki has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Do I have The Package ready to reposition or engage? Corki's Special Delivery is his most impactful cooldown — use it to open fights, escape ganks, or split lanes. Never sit on The Package too long; the repositioning value is often worth more than the damage.

champions.name: Darius
champions.title: Champion #26
champions.description: Darius is a Top lane champion.
strengths: Darius has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Do I have 5 Hemorrhage stacks on my target for the true damage execute? Every Darius play revolves around stacking his passive bleed to 5 for a Noxian Guillotine true damage execute. Use Decimate's outer edge for maximum damage and pull enemies back in with Apprehend when they try to escape.

champions.name: Diana
champions.title: Champion #27
champions.description: Diana is a Jungle lane champion.
strengths: Diana has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Is my Moonsilver Blade third hit ready to burst someone? Diana's power comes in bursts tied to her passive. Engage with Q to empower your passive, then use R to gap close and unleash the empowered auto. Always have an escape plan since Diana has no built-in disengage once she commits.

champions.name: Dr.Mundo
champions.title: Champion #28
champions.description: Dr.Mundo is a Top lane champion.
strengths: Dr.Mundo has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Am I building enough Grievous Wounds resistance or should I build more HP? Dr. Mundo is a walking health bar — the more max HP he builds, the more his ultimate heals and the harder he is to kill. Activate Sadism at 30-40% health for maximum healing and never fight without it available.

champions.name: Draven
champions.title: Champion #29
champions.description: Draven is a ADC lane champion.
strengths: Draven has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Am I catching all my axes and keeping my League of Draven stacks alive? Draven's entire kit is built around catching Spinning Axes to redeploy them. Position your champion where the axe will land, not where you are now. A Draven who drops axes is just a weaker marksman.

champions.name: Ekko
champions.title: Champion #30
champions.description: Ekko is a Mid lane champion.
strengths: Ekko has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Is my Chronobreak positioned well enough to guarantee my survival after engaging? Always check your ghost's position before diving. Place your E through enemies to proc your passive stun, burst your target, then Chronobreak back to safety. Never engage without a clear escape path through your ultimate.

champions.name: Elise
champions.title: Champion #31
champions.description: Elise is a Jungle lane champion.
strengths: Elise has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Is my target low enough for Spider Form rappel-execute or do I need Human Form CC first? Elise is strongest levels 3-6 before enemies get defensive items. Always open with Human Form stun then transform for Venomous Bite execute. Rappel to dodge crucial skillshots, not just to escape.

champions.name: Evelynn
champions.title: Champion #32
champions.description: Evelynn is a Jungle lane champion.
strengths: Evelynn has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Am I using my post-6 camouflage to gather information, not just to kill? Evelynn's invisibility is as valuable for scouting as it is for ganking. Walk into the enemy jungle to track their jungler's position, check Dragon and Baron timing, and only commit to a gank when you can guarantee a kill.

champions.name: Ezreal
champions.title: Champion #33
champions.description: Ezreal is a ADC lane champion.
strengths: Ezreal has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Am I using Mystic Shot to farm and reduce cooldowns even when I can't poke? Every Mystic Shot hit reduces all your cooldowns by 1.5 seconds. Use it constantly on minions to keep Arcane Shift available as an escape. Never hold W or R — use them for waveclear or long-range poke.

champions.name: Fiddlesticks
champions.title: Champion #34
champions.description: Fiddlesticks is a Jungle lane champion.
strengths: Fiddlesticks has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Is my ultimate positioned to catch the enemy team completely off-guard? Fiddlesticks' Crowstorm is only as good as the surprise factor. Place a ward deep in enemy territory and teleport to it mid-fight rather than engaging from obvious angles. A predicted Crowstorm is a wasted ultimate.

champions.name: Fiora
champions.title: Champion #35
champions.description: Fiora is a Top lane champion.
strengths: Fiora has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Where are the enemy's Vitals and can I safely proc them? Fiora's Grand Challenge reveals 4 Vitals on each enemy. Always track which side of the enemy the next Vital is on before engaging. Procing all 4 Vitals in a fight triggers a healing zone that can make an unwinnable fight winnable.

champions.name: Fizz
champions.title: Champion #36
champions.description: Fizz is a Mid lane champion.
strengths: Fizz has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Have I baited out the most dangerous enemy ability before using Playful Trickster? Fizz's E is his only defensive tool — don't waste it dodging a low-damage ability. Save it to dodge crucial CC like Lux snare or Syndra stun, then reengage after the threat has passed.

champions.name: Galio
champions.title: Champion #37
champions.description: Galio is a Mid lane champion.
strengths: Galio has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Which side of the map needs my Hero's Entrance the most right now? Galio's global ultimate makes him the best roaming mid laner in the game. Always track both sideline fights and use Hero's Entrance to turn a losing fight into a winning one. A perfectly timed R can win a game from across the map.

champions.name: Gangplank
champions.title: Champion #38
champions.description: Gangplank is a Top lane champion.
strengths: Gangplank has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Am I using Trial by Fire and Powder Kegs efficiently to maximize damage? Gangplank's damage comes from empowered autos through kegs. Always stack kegs before trading, then detonate them with your empowered auto for massive burst. Use Cannon Barrage to influence fights globally even when split pushing.

champions.name: Garen
champions.title: Champion #39
champions.description: Garen is a Top lane champion.
strengths: Garen has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Is the enemy below half health and do I have Villain mark for true damage execute? Garen's Demacian Justice deals true damage to the Villain (highest threat enemy). Focus your silence on ability-reliant champions and always chase with Q speed boost before spinning to maximize Judgment damage.

champions.name: Gnar
champions.title: Champion #40
champions.description: Gnar is a Top lane champion.
strengths: Gnar has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: How full is my Rage meter and is the enemy near a wall for Mega Gnar knockup? Mini Gnar pokes and stacks Rage safely from range — Mega Gnar all-ins with massive CC. Never force a Mega Gnar fight in the open; always position near walls so GNAR! knocks enemies into the wall for maximum stun duration.

champions.name: Gragas
champions.title: Champion #41
champions.description: Gragas is a Top lane champion.
strengths: Gragas has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Will my Explosive Cask knock enemies into my team or away from them? Gragas R is a double-edged tool — it can save allies by knocking enemies away or win fights by knocking enemies into your team. Always decide the direction before pressing R. A backwards knockaway on a diving assassin saves your carry.

champions.name: Graves
champions.title: Champion #42
champions.description: Graves is a Jungle lane champion.
strengths: Graves has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Am I using terrain to reload and maintain my True Grit armor stacks? Graves gains armor for being in combat and loses it when hit. Stay close to walls for cover while reloading your shotgun, and always look to fight in narrow jungle corridors where your shotgun spread hits multiple pellets on one target.

champions.name: Gwen
champions.title: Champion #43
champions.description: Gwen is a Top lane champion.
strengths: Gwen has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Is the enemy inside my Hallowed Mist where they can't target me? Gwen's W makes her untargetable to enemies outside the mist. Reposition the mist on top of yourself when enemies try to attack from outside it, and always activate it before a tank or bruiser tries to itemize against you.

champions.name: Hecarim
champions.title: Champion #44
champions.description: Hecarim is a Jungle lane champion.
strengths: Hecarim has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Am I building enough movement speed to maximize my passive damage? Hecarim's Warpath converts bonus movement speed into attack damage. Stack Phantom Rush speed, ghost, and movement speed items to reach insane damage. Use Onslaught of Shadows from maximum range to knock enemies toward your team.

champions.name: Heimerdinger
champions.title: Champion #45
champions.description: Heimerdinger is a Mid lane champion.
strengths: Heimerdinger has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Are my turrets placed to deny the enemy the ability to walk forward safely? Heimerdinger controls zones with his turrets, not just deals damage. Place H-28G turrets at chokepoints before fights start — a well-placed turret triangle makes an entire area deadly to walk through and forces enemies to play around you.

champions.name: Hwei
champions.title: Champion #46
champions.description: Hwei is a Mid lane champion.
strengths: Hwei has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Which of my three ability books does this situation call for? Hwei has three ability sets for damage, CC, and utility. Don't autopilot one combo — use the Serenity book for healing and shields when your team is fighting and the Disaster book when enemies are CC'd and vulnerable to burst.

champions.name: Illaoi
champions.title: Champion #47
champions.description: Illaoi is a Top lane champion.
strengths: Illaoi has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Are enough tentacles spawned and close enough to amplify my Test of Spirit? Illaoi is immovable but devastating when enemies fight her near tentacles. Dodge Illaoi's Q by walking along her sides not directly away, and never fight her when she has 3+ tentacles nearby. Force her into open areas where tentacles can't reach.

champions.name: Irelia
champions.title: Champion #48
champions.description: Irelia is a Top lane champion.
strengths: Irelia has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Do I have 4 or 5 stacks on my Ionian Fervor passive before engaging? Irelia at max stacks is nearly untouchable — she has massive attack speed and bonus damage. Never engage a full team without max stacks. Farm minions to stack before a teamfight and always dash through minions to reset Bladesurge cooldown.

champions.name: Ivern
champions.title: Champion #49
champions.description: Ivern is a Jungle lane champion.
strengths: Ivern has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Is Daisy available and is this the right moment to deploy her in a teamfight? Ivern is a utility jungler — your value is in Daisy knockups and Triggerseed shields. Never rush to clear camps when you can steal enemy camps with Friend of the Forest. Prioritize placing Daisy between enemies and your carry.

champions.name: Janna
champions.title: Champion #50
champions.description: Janna is a Support lane champion.
strengths: Janna has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Should I use my ultimate to disengage a bad fight or engage a good one? Janna's Monsoon can win a fight by healing your team while knocking enemies away. Use it reactively when your team is getting burst — never offensively. Your Howling Gale is most effective when fully charged so always wind it up before releasing.

champions.name: Jarvan
champions.title: Champion #51
champions.description: Jarvan is a Mid lane champion.
strengths: Jarvan has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Will my Cataclysm trap the right enemies or accidentally trap the wrong ones? Jarvan's ultimate creates an arena that traps everyone inside — including allies. Never ult around your own carries who need to move freely. Use it to isolate and trap a single carry away from their peel, then burst them inside.

champions.name: Jax
champions.title: Champion #53
champions.description: Jax is a Top lane champion.
strengths: Jax has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Is my Counter Strike passive stacked enough to dodge and stun before I all-in? Jax's dodge window is his most powerful tool. Activate Counter Strike, bait out auto attacks, then stun when it detonates. Never fight a ranged champion in Counter Strike since it only dodges basic attacks, not abilities.

champions.name: Jayce
champions.title: Champion #54
champions.description: Jayce is a Top lane champion.
strengths: Jayce has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Which form does this phase of the fight require — poke range or close burst? Jayce swaps between ranged poke and melee burst. Open with Cannon Form to poke, then transform to Hammer Form when enemies close distance for the full combo. Never get caught in Hammer Form at range or Cannon Form in melee range.

champions.name: Jhin
champions.title: Champion #55
champions.description: Jhin is a ADC lane champion.
strengths: Jhin has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Is the 4th shot available on a rooted or slowed enemy for my critical hit? Jhin's 4th shot is his highest damage and always crits. Set it up by rooting enemies with Deadly Flourish or Captive Audience traps. Never fire the 4th shot on a moving target — land CC first then unload for guaranteed maximum damage.

champions.name: Jinx
champions.title: Champion #56
champions.description: Jinx is a ADC lane champion.
strengths: Jinx has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Are enemies grouped enough for my rockets and do I have a kill for Get Excited? Jinx needs a kill or assist to activate her passive movement speed. Position safely at max range and wait for the fight to develop before committing — one reset turns Jinx from a backline ADC into an unstoppable cleanup machine.

champions.name: K'Sante
champions.title: Champion #57
champions.description: K'Sante is a Top lane champion.
strengths: K'Sante has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Do I want to be a tank right now or all-in with my ultimate? K'Sante transforms from a durable tank to a mobile fighter with All Out. Use your tank form to absorb damage and peel, then activate All Out to dive the enemy carry with massive mobility. Don't use R defensively — it's an offensive commitment.

champions.name: Kai'Sa
champions.title: Champion #58
champions.description: Kai'Sa is a ADC lane champion.
strengths: Kai'Sa has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Is the enemy already CC'd before I use my ultimate to dive them? Kai'Sa's Killer Instinct is a dive tool not an escape tool. Always use it to jump onto an already CC'd carry — never use it to start a fight since you'll get CC'd mid-channel. Your evolved Q needs 5 stacks of Plasma so apply passive before the big combo.

champions.name: Kalista
champions.title: Champion #59
champions.description: Kalista is a ADC lane champion.
strengths: Kalista has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Is my soul bond partner in position for me to use Fate's Call effectively? Kalista's ultimate only works if your bound ally is nearby and ready to engage. Communicate with your support about when to activate Fate's Call — a surprise Blitzcrank or Leona launch from your throw can instantly win a teamfight.

champions.name: Karma
champions.title: Champion #60
champions.description: Karma is a Support lane champion.
strengths: Karma has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Should I use Mantra for damage, a shield, or a movement speed boost right now? Karma's Mantra empowers three different abilities for three different situations. Mantra Q for damage and slow, Mantra W for a big shield and root, Mantra E for team movement speed in chases. Always have Mantra ready for the most impactful moment.

champions.name: Karthus
champions.title: Champion #61
champions.description: Karthus is a Jungle lane champion.
strengths: Karthus has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Is the enemy team spread across the map with low health targets I can finish with Requiem? Karthus's global ultimate Requiem hits all enemies simultaneously. Always scan the minimap for low-health enemies before pressing R. Cast it during or right after a fight when enemies are damaged from combat, not at full health.

champions.name: Kassadin
champions.title: Champion #62
champions.description: Kassadin is a Mid lane champion.
strengths: Kassadin has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Am I at level 16 with 3 points in Riftwalk for maximum power? Kassadin is intentionally weak early to compensate for his late-game dominance. Play extremely safe before level 11, build Seraph's Embrace for mana, and only look to carry after level 16 when Riftwalk reaches its maximum potential.

champions.name: Katarina
champions.title: Champion #63
champions.description: Katarina is a Mid lane champion.
strengths: Katarina has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Are enemy summoners and key cooldowns already used before I all-in? Katarina has no hard CC and wins purely by out-damaging enemies during resets. Never engage as the first one into a fight — wait for teammates to use enemy flashes and CC, then dive in and chain resets from the resulting kills.

champions.name: Kayle
champions.title: Champion #64
champions.description: Kayle is a Top lane champion.
strengths: Kayle has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Am I at my power spike levels (6, 11, 16) and playing accordingly? Kayle has the most dramatic power curve in the game — weak early, unstoppable late. Never fight before level 6, start trading at 11 when you gain ranged form, and after level 16 you are a full ranged carry who should dominate every fight.

champions.name: Kayn
champions.title: Champion #65
champions.description: Kayn is a Jungle lane champion.
strengths: Kayn has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Which form should I be collecting orbs for based on the enemy team composition? Rhaast (red) is better against tanky teams, Shadow Assassin (blue) against squishy teams. Actively choose which enemies to fight to collect the right colored orbs. Unlocking your form before 15 minutes is a major power spike.

champions.name: Kennen
champions.title: Champion #66
champions.description: Kennen is a Top lane champion.
strengths: Kennen has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Are at least 3 enemies grouped for my Lightning Rush plus Slicing Maelstrom? Kennen's ultimate combined with Zhonya's Hourglass is a classic combo. Dive into the enemy team with E, ult, then immediately Zhonya's to survive while your ultimate ticks damage and stuns everyone around you.

champions.name: Kha'Zix
champions.title: Champion #67
champions.description: Kha'Zix is a Jungle lane champion.
strengths: Kha'Zix has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Is my target isolated with no nearby allies so my passive bonus damage activates? Kha'Zix's Unseen Threat passive and Q deal massively increased damage to isolated targets. Always check if your target has allies within 500 units before engaging — diving a non-isolated target removes your most powerful damage multiplier.

champions.name: Kindred
champions.title: Champion #68
champions.description: Kindred is a Jungle lane champion.
strengths: Kindred has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Have I marked and killed enough targets to build Kindred stacks and is the Lambda on an enemy camp I can contest? Kindred's marks are the core of their scaling. Prioritize marked enemy camps in the enemy jungle over normal camps. Your ultimate Lamb's Respite saves both allies and enemies — use it to save a key ally from an execute.

champions.name: Kled
champions.title: Champion #69
champions.description: Kled is a Top lane champion.
strengths: Kled has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Is Skaarl dismounted and do I need to play defensively to remount? Kled has two health bars but loses Skaarl at 40% health. When dismounted, play extremely cautiously and hit enemies 5 times to remount. Once remounted you regain all your mobility — the enemy should fear your remount as much as your initial engage.

champions.name: Kog'Maw
champions.title: Champion #70
champions.description: Kog'Maw is a ADC lane champion.
strengths: Kog'Maw has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Is my Bio-Arcane Barrage active and am I maximizing uptime on its bonus range? Kog'Maw's W doubles his attack range temporarily — activate it before every trade and teamfight. You have zero mobility so positioning before fights start is everything. Always stay behind tanks and let your massive range do the work.

champions.name: LeBlanc
champions.title: Champion #71
champions.description: LeBlanc is a Mid lane champion.
strengths: LeBlanc has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Have I created enough confusion with my clone to bait out enemy abilities? LeBlanc's Mirror Image clone is most valuable when enemies waste CC on it. After using R, immediately move in the opposite direction of your clone to maximize confusion. A good LeBlanc uses her clone proactively, not just to escape.

champions.name: Lee
champions.title: Champion #72
champions.description: Lee is a Mid lane champion.
strengths: Lee has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Is my Dragon's Rage kick going to send the enemy into my team or away from them? Lee Sin's ultimate is only as good as its positioning. Kick enemies toward your team, into walls, or under your tower. A badly aimed Dragon's Rage that kicks enemies to safety is worse than not kicking at all — always check angles first.

champions.name: Leona
champions.title: Champion #74
champions.description: Leona is a Support lane champion.
strengths: Leona has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Is my ADC in range and ready to follow up my engage before I use Solar Flare? Leona is fully commit — there is no going back once you Zenith Blade into an enemy. Only engage when your ADC is positioned to follow up within 1 second. A Leona engage with no follow-up is just a free death.

champions.name: Lillia
champions.title: Champion #75
champions.description: Lillia is a Jungle lane champion.
strengths: Lillia has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Have I applied enough Lilting Lullaby stacks to put multiple enemies to sleep? Lillia's ultimate puts to sleep all enemies with her passive mark. Stack the mark by hitting multiple enemies with your abilities in a teamfight, then cast Lilting Lullaby to mass sleep. One good ultimate can completely neutralize the enemy team.

champions.name: Lissandra
champions.title: Champion #76
champions.description: Lissandra is a Mid lane champion.
strengths: Lissandra has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Should I use my ultimate on myself to survive or on an enemy to CC them? Lissandra's Frozen Tomb has two uses — encasing yourself for invulnerability or rooting an enemy in ice. In close fights, use it on yourself to survive burst damage. In winning fights, use it on the enemy carry to keep them locked down.

champions.name: Lucian
champions.title: Champion #77
champions.description: Lucian is a ADC lane champion.
strengths: Lucian has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Am I canceling the end of abilities with auto attacks to proc Lightslinger passive? Lucian's double-shot passive triggers after every ability. The key to high Lucian damage is the ability-auto-ability-auto rhythm. Practice canceling the end of Ardent Blaze and Relentless Pursuit with immediate auto attacks.

champions.name: Lulu
champions.title: Champion #78
champions.description: Lulu is a Support lane champion.
strengths: Lulu has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Which ally needs my Wild Growth ultimate the most — the one diving or the one being dived? Lulu's R is best used on a hypercarry diving into the enemy team or to save an ally from a burst combo. Never use it offensively if your backline is in danger. Polymorph the most threatening enemy diver immediately.

champions.name: Lux
champions.title: Champion #79
champions.description: Lux is a Mid lane champion.
strengths: Lux has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Have I hit my E Lucent Singularity before detonating it to maximize slow and damage? Lux's combo requires setup — land Q root, then throw E into the rooted enemy, detonate E, then fire R. Never skip steps in the combo. Use Final Spark to poke at max range whenever it's available since its cooldown resets on Illumination procs.

champions.name: Malphite
champions.title: Champion #80
champions.description: Malphite is a Top lane champion.
strengths: Malphite has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Are at least 3 enemies grouped for an Unstoppable Force engage that will hit all of them? Malphite's ultimate is one of the best teamfight openers in the game but it needs to hit multiple enemies. Never ult one person — wait for enemies to group around an objective or during a skirmish and always communicate before you ult.

champions.name: Malzahar
champions.title: Champion #81
champions.description: Malzahar is a Mid lane champion.
strengths: Malzahar has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Is the target I want to suppress with Nether Grasp already out of position and can I survive the channel? Malzahar's ultimate is a 2.5 second channel suppression — both you and the enemy are locked in place. Use Quicksilver Sash awareness — if enemies have QSS, don't ult first. Void Swarm voidlings protect you during the channel.

champions.name: Maokai
champions.title: Champion #82
champions.description: Maokai is a Top lane champion.
strengths: Maokai has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Am I using Sapling Toss in brushes where enemies can't see them until it's too late? Maokai's saplings deal double damage in brush and chase enemies. Place them in objectives, river bushes, and escape routes before fights start. Your Nature's Grasp ultimate is best used in narrow corridors where enemies can't sidestep the roots.

champions.name: Master
champions.title: Champion #83
champions.description: Master is a Mid lane champion.
strengths: Master has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Are all major CC abilities on cooldown before I press R and all-in? Master Yi dies instantly to CC — never engage without knowing where enemy hard CC is. Use Alpha Strike to dodge crucial skillshots like Malzahar ult or Warwick grab. Wuju Style true damage shreds tanks so don't ignore them as targets.

champions.name: Mel
champions.title: Champion #85
champions.description: Mel is a Mid lane champion.
strengths: Mel has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Am I using Mel's range advantage to poke safely before committing to a full combo? Stay at maximum range and look for opportunities when enemies are CC'd or out of position.

champions.name: Milio
champions.title: Champion #86
champions.description: Milio is a Support lane champion.
strengths: Milio has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Is my Fired Up passive buff on my carry before they trade? Milio's passive extends ally attack range when he heals them. Always keep your carry buffed with Fired Up before a skirmish. Ultra Mega Fire Kick is your only CC — use it to interrupt dashes and channeled abilities rather than on stationary targets.

champions.name: Miss
champions.title: Champion #87
champions.description: Miss is a Mid lane champion.
strengths: Miss has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Are enemies funneling through a chokepoint where my Bullet Time will hit all of them? Miss Fortune's ultimate is a channeled cone that shreds grouped enemies. Position to fire it through a doorway, jungle entrance, or when enemies are fleeing in a line. Love Tap passive bonus damage is maximized by switching targets between autos.

champions.name: Mordekaiser
champions.title: Champion #89
champions.description: Mordekaiser is a Top lane champion.
strengths: Mordekaiser has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Do I have enough items to win a 1v1 in the Death Realm against who I'm planning to ultimate? Realm of Death removes all external influences — it's purely 1v1. Only ult champions you can beat solo. Stealing the enemy's stats with your passive makes the fight even more one-sided in your favor if you have more items.

champions.name: Morgana
champions.title: Champion #90
champions.description: Morgana is a Support lane champion.
strengths: Morgana has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Should I use Black Shield on my carry proactively or reactively? Morgana's Black Shield absorbs magic damage and CC — use it just before the enemy lands CC, not after. Watch for incoming Blitzcrank hooks, Lux snares, or Leona engages and shield your carry a half-second before they land.

champions.name: Naafiri
champions.title: Champion #91
champions.description: Naafiri is a Mid lane champion.
strengths: Naafiri has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Are my packmates alive and in position to amplify my damage before I engage? Naafiri's hounds provide extra damage and distraction during fights. Let your packmates hit the target first to spread their attention, then dash in for the full burst combo. Always re-summon hounds when they die during skirmishes.

champions.name: Nami
champions.title: Champion #92
champions.description: Nami is a Support lane champion.
strengths: Nami has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Am I using Tidecaller's Blessing empowered autos to proc slows and push enemies away? Nami's W empowers three autos with bonus damage and slow. Apply it to your carry before every trade — an ADC with Tidecaller's Blessing autos is significantly stronger in short trades. Tidal Wave is best used in narrow corridors.

champions.name: Nasus
champions.title: Champion #93
champions.description: Nasus is a Top lane champion.
strengths: Nasus has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Do I have at least 300 Siphoning Strike stacks before I start fighting aggressively? Nasus scales infinitely with Q stacks — every game is about farming stacks safely until you reach critical mass. With 300+ stacks your Q one-shots most targets. Use Wither to slow a single carry to 20% movement speed in every teamfight.

champions.name: Nautilus
champions.title: Champion #94
champions.description: Nautilus is a Support lane champion.
strengths: Nautilus has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Am I hitting my Dredge Line hooks reliably or should I angle them differently? Nautilus has more CC than almost any champion in the game but it all depends on landing the hook. Practice hook angles and always throw hooks at enemy feet not their body since it's a larger hitbox. Your passive root triggers on every first auto.

champions.name: Neeko
champions.title: Champion #95
champions.description: Neeko is a Mid lane champion.
strengths: Neeko has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Am I using my Inherent Glamour disguise to gather information and set up unexpected plays? Neeko's passive lets her disguise as allies to confuse enemies. Walk into a sidelane disguised as a harmless support to bait out enemy overextension, then reveal yourself for the kill. Pop Blossom under the enemy team from a disguised walk-up.

champions.name: Nidalee
champions.title: Champion #96
champions.description: Nidalee is a Jungle lane champion.
strengths: Nidalee has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Have I landed a spear before switching to Cougar form to complete the burst combo? Nidalee's damage is all about the Javelin Toss hit into Pounce plus Takedown combo. Never transform to Cougar without a spear already landed on the target. Use Bushwhack traps to reveal enemy wards and trigger hunt mode for bonus mobility.

champions.name: Nilah
champions.title: Champion #97
champions.description: Nilah is a ADC lane champion.
strengths: Nilah has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Is there a support with AOE healing nearby so my passive can share that healing? Nilah's Jubilant Veil passive shares a portion of ally heals and shields with her and nearby allies. Stack this with enchanters like Soraka or Lulu for massive sustain in lane. Use Apotheosis ultimate to drag enemies into you from a crowd.

champions.name: Nocturne
champions.title: Champion #98
champions.description: Nocturne is a Jungle lane champion.
strengths: Nocturne has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Is Paranoia's global darkness removing vision from a fight where your team has a numbers advantage? Nocturne's ultimate blinds the entire map for the enemy team. Use Paranoia right before a teamfight starts so enemies can't see who your team is targeting. The vision denial is often more valuable than the dive itself.

champions.name: Nunu
champions.title: Champion #99
champions.description: Nunu is a Mid lane champion.
strengths: Nunu has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Can I use Absolute Zero in a position where enemies are trapped by terrain and can't walk out of range? Nunu's ultimate is powerful but easily escaped by walking out of range. Cast it in narrow corridors, under towers, or when enemies are CC'd. Snowball is a global threat — always roll it toward objectives and dragon or baron.

champions.name: Olaf
champions.title: Champion #101
champions.description: Olaf is a Top lane champion.
strengths: Olaf has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Is Ragnarok active and am I targeting the enemy carry directly rather than getting distracted? Olaf with his ultimate is CC-immune and should run straight at the enemy backline ignoring all crowd control. Never waste Ragnarok on frontline tanks — use it to cut through the enemy team and reach their ADC or mid laner.

champions.name: Orianna
champions.title: Champion #102
champions.description: Orianna is a Mid lane champion.
strengths: Orianna has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Is my ball positioned on the right target before I press R for Shockwave? Orianna's ultimate Shockwave pulls all enemies near the ball toward it. The best Orianna ultimates pull 3-5 enemies into your team from an unexpected angle. Always try to attach the ball to a diving ally so the enemy team chases them right into your R.

champions.name: Ornn
champions.title: Champion #103
champions.description: Ornn is a Top lane champion.
strengths: Ornn has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Am I using Call of the Forge God ultimate from maximum range for the double knockup? Ornn's R can be recast to redirect and create a double knockup. Always cast it at maximum range, let it travel to create distance, then recast it to charge through enemies. The upgrade items you craft for teammates are game-changing — prioritize upgrades on your carries first.

champions.name: Pantheon
champions.title: Champion #104
champions.description: Pantheon is a Top lane champion.
strengths: Pantheon has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Is my Mortal Will passive fully stacked for the empowered ability before I engage? Pantheon's fifth stack empowers his next ability — empowered W stuns, empowered E blocks all frontal damage. Always engage with 5 stacks available and use Grand Starfall to appear in sidelines or mid fight for unexpected flanks.

champions.name: Poppy
champions.title: Champion #105
champions.description: Poppy is a Top lane champion.
strengths: Poppy has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Is the most mobile enemy champion near a wall so I can pin them with Keeper's Verdict? Poppy's kit is designed to neutralize mobile carries and junglers. Use Heroic Charge to pin enemies against walls for maximum stun duration. Her W Steadfast Presence prevents all dashes in range — activate it when mobile enemies try to engage.

champions.name: Pyke
champions.title: Champion #106
champions.description: Pyke is a Support lane champion.
strengths: Pyke has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Is the enemy in my X-shaped execute zone and below the Death from Below health threshold? Pyke's R resets on kills and gives the gold to his lane partner. Prioritize kills where your ADC gets the gold rather than last-hitting everything yourself. Use Ghostwater Dive to roam invisibly to mid and top after winning bot lane.

champions.name: Qiyana
champions.title: Champion #107
champions.description: Qiyana is a Mid lane champion.
strengths: Qiyana has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Which elemental edge gives me the best tool for this situation — river CC, wall stun, or grass stealth? Qiyana's power changes based on which element she has. River edge creates slowing terrain, rock wall creates a stun explosion with her ultimate, grass edge grants stealth. Always check the map for available elements before engaging.

champions.name: Quinn
champions.title: Champion #108
champions.description: Quinn is a Mid lane champion.
strengths: Quinn has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Should I use Behind Enemy Lines to rotate to another lane or stay and split push? Quinn has the fastest split push rotation in the game via her ultimate. After winning a trade top lane, immediately R and run to mid or bot to create a 2-lane pressure situation. Always track enemy jungler position before extended roams.

champions.name: Rakan
champions.title: Champion #109
champions.description: Rakan is a Support lane champion.
strengths: Rakan has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Is Grand Entrance going to land me in a position where I can follow up with The Quickness charm? Rakan's engage combo is Grand Entrance knockup into The Quickness dash that charms everyone he touches. Always chain them immediately — use W to get into range then activate R as you dash through the enemy team for maximum charms.

champions.name: Rammus
champions.title: Champion #110
champions.description: Rammus is a Jungle lane champion.
strengths: Rammus has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Are there multiple auto-attack champions on the enemy team that I should build Thornmail against? Rammus's Spiked Shell passive reflects damage back to attackers. The more AA-heavy the enemy team, the more damage Rammus naturally deals. Powerball into Puncturing Taunt on the ADC forces them to auto-attack themselves to death.

champions.name: Rek'Sai
champions.title: Champion #111
champions.description: Rek'Sai is a Jungle lane champion.
strengths: Rek'Sai has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Have I set up enough tunnels in strategic locations before ganking? Rek'Sai's Void Rush tunnels create global mobility. Place tunnels at dragon, baron, and all three lanes for maximum map coverage. Unburrow knockup is instant and unavoidable — always approach from directly below the target by burrowing next to them first.

champions.name: Rell
champions.title: Champion #112
champions.description: Rell is a Support lane champion.
strengths: Rell has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Can I use my Ferromancy mount toggle to reposition quickly or slow myself for a fight? Rell in dismounted form moves slowly but has massive CC. Use mounted form to chase and roam, dismount for fights. Magnet Storm ultimate pulls all nearby enemies to you — use it after getting into the center of the enemy team.

champions.name: Renata
champions.title: Champion #113
champions.description: Renata is a Mid lane champion.
strengths: Renata has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Is Hostile Takeover in a position where enemies will fight each other rather than your team? Renata's ultimate causes enemies to go berserk and attack each other. For maximum value, cast it on clustered enemies mid-fight so they damage their own allies. Bailout can revive a dead ally — communicate with your team about who to use it on.

champions.name: Renekton
champions.title: Champion #115
champions.description: Renekton is a Top lane champion.
strengths: Renekton has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Do I have 50+ Fury before engaging for the empowered Ruthless Predator stun? Renekton's empowered W at 50 Fury stuns for 1.5 seconds — his most powerful tool. Build Fury by using Cull the Meek to heal back, then unleash the full combo. Slice and Dice through minions to maintain the empowered state after engaging.

champions.name: Rengar
champions.title: Champion #116
champions.description: Rengar is a Jungle lane champion.
strengths: Rengar has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Do I have 4 Ferocity stacks ready for an empowered ability before I jump from brush? Rengar's empowered Q from max ferocity stacks is a massive burst of damage. Always build to 4 stacks in brush before leaping. Thrill of the Hunt ultimate reveals the nearest enemy — use it to track fleeing enemies and for unseen approach.

champions.name: Riven
champions.title: Champion #117
champions.description: Riven is a Top lane champion.
strengths: Riven has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Am I weaving auto attacks between every ability to maximize damage output? Riven's damage comes from animation-canceling abilities with auto attacks — the Q-auto-Q-auto-Q-auto chain is her entire identity. Without auto cancels she deals half damage. Use Wind Slash R2 only when enemies are below 75% health for bonus damage.

champions.name: Rumble
champions.title: Champion #118
champions.description: Rumble is a Top lane champion.
strengths: Rumble has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Is my heat between 50-99 for Danger Zone bonus damage without overheating? Rumble deals 20% bonus damage at 50-99 heat but becomes silenced if he overheats. Manage heat carefully — ride the Danger Zone threshold during trades. The Equalizer ultimate is best fired perpendicular to the enemy team so they can't walk out of it.

champions.name: Ryze
champions.title: Champion #119
champions.description: Ryze is a Mid lane champion.
strengths: Ryze has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Is Realm Warp positioned in a location that will create a tactical advantage when your team teleports? Ryze's ultimate can teleport your entire team across the map. Use it to flank from an unexpected direction, teleport to an ally in danger, or create a rapid baron/dragon steal. Never use it just to reposition — use it for massive tactical plays.

champions.name: Samira
champions.title: Champion #120
champions.description: Samira is a ADC lane champion.
strengths: Samira has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Do I have Style grade S (6 stacks) before activating Inferno Trigger for maximum damage? Samira's ultimate only activates at S rank. Build your combo rank by alternating melee and ranged attacks and weaving in abilities. Use Blade Whirl to destroy incoming projectiles, then build to S rank while enemies waste abilities on your spin.

champions.name: Sejuani
champions.title: Champion #121
champions.description: Sejuani is a Jungle lane champion.
strengths: Sejuani has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Is the enemy already hit by Frost passive so one more CC ability will stun them? Sejuani's Permafrost stuns enemies who already have Frost applied. Apply Frost with Arctic Assault, then detonate it with W or E for the stun. Her glacial Prison ultimate is a skillshot — aim it at feet not the champion model for reliable hits.

champions.name: Senna
champions.title: Champion #122
champions.description: Senna is a Support lane champion.
strengths: Senna has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Am I collecting enough Mist Wraith souls to scale my range and damage throughout the game? Senna gets stronger every time she collects a soul — last-hit every Mist Wraith to maximize scaling. Her global Dawning Shadow ultimate can shield allies anywhere on the map so watch for low-health allies needing emergency shielding.

champions.name: Seraphine
champions.title: Champion #123
champions.description: Seraphine is a Support lane champion.
strengths: Seraphine has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Am I hitting both sides of Beat Drop to maximize the CC on multiple targets? Seraphine's E roots enemies at the end of the push and slow enemies at the edges. Position it to push enemies into each other rather than apart. Her ultimate Encore charms all enemies it passes through — aim it through the longest line of enemies possible.

champions.name: Sett
champions.title: Champion #124
champions.description: Sett is a Top lane champion.
strengths: Sett has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Have I stored enough Grit from taking damage to make The Show Stopper deal massive true damage? Sett's W true damage scales off how much Grit he's stored from taking hits. Deliberately soak some damage before using Haymaker to maximize its damage. Facebreaker suppresses enemies on both sides — walk through the enemy team to hit multiple.

champions.name: Shaco
champions.title: Champion #125
champions.description: Shaco is a Jungle lane champion.
strengths: Shaco has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Are my Jack in the Box traps placed in locations enemies will actually walk through? Shaco's boxes placed in dark areas where enemies ward or path will trigger fear chains. Pre-place boxes before dragon and baron spawns, in common gank paths, and at buff camps to deny the enemy jungler. Deceive backstab bonus damage requires positioning behind the target.

champions.name: Shen
champions.title: Champion #126
champions.description: Shen is a Top lane champion.
strengths: Shen has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Which ally is fighting the most dangerous duel right now and needs my Stand United global teleport? Shen's ultimate Stand United teleports him to any ally and shields them — it can completely save losing fights across the map. Always track 1v1 duels elsewhere on the map. A Shen who never uses his ultimate is half a champion.

champions.name: Shyvana
champions.title: Champion #127
champions.description: Shyvana is a Jungle lane champion.
strengths: Shyvana has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Do I have enough Fury to transform and how should I position Dragon Form for maximum impact? Shyvana needs Dragon Form for teamfights but Fury only generates through combat. Farm and fight early to have full Fury for important objectives. Dragon Form Flame Breath leaves a burning area — land it under the enemy team at dragon or baron.

champions.name: Singed
champions.title: Champion #128
champions.description: Singed is a Top lane champion.
strengths: Singed has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Am I running through the enemy team with Insanity Potion active to maximize poison spread? Singed deals damage by running near enemies, not by standing and casting. Activate Ghost and Insanity Potion before fights, then run through as many enemies as possible spreading Poison Trail. Fling carries into your team, not away from it.

champions.name: Sion
champions.title: Champion #129
champions.description: Sion is a Top lane champion.
strengths: Sion has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Am I using Decimating Smash's full charge for maximum knockup distance and damage? Sion's Q deals far more damage and travels further when fully charged. In lane, fake a charge to bait out movement then recharge for the real hit. Unstoppable Onslaught is best used to start teamfights from unexpected flanking angles.

champions.name: Sivir
champions.title: Champion #130
champions.description: Sivir is a ADC lane champion.
strengths: Sivir has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Is On The Hunt available to give my team the movement speed needed to chase or disengage? Sivir's ultimate gives your entire team a massive movement speed boost — use it to chase down kills after winning a fight or to disengage when losing. Spell Shield timing is crucial — save it for hard CC not poke damage.

champions.name: Skarner
champions.title: Champion #131
champions.description: Skarner is a Jungle lane champion.
strengths: Skarner has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Am I using Impale to drag the enemy carry into my team rather than away from them? Skarner's suppression drags enemies with him — always drag toward your team, not away. Capture spires in the enemy jungle to gain empowered abilities — holding all three spires makes Skarner significantly more powerful.

champions.name: Smolder
champions.title: Champion #132
champions.description: Smolder is a ADC lane champion.
strengths: Smolder has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Have I stacked enough Dragon Practice charges to significantly boost my Q damage? Smolder scales with each Q stack — the first 225 stacks dramatically increase damage. Prioritize hitting as many Qs as possible early game, even on minions. Super Scorcher Breath ultimate is a heal for allies it passes over — aim it through your team first.

champions.name: Sona
champions.title: Champion #133
champions.description: Sona is a Support lane champion.
strengths: Sona has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Am I hitting Power Chord empowered autos on the right target for the right effect? Sona's Power Chord changes effect based on last ability used — Q chord damages, W chord reduces damage, E chord slows. Always use W chord on the most threatening damage dealer before they burst your carry. Crescendo ultimate is best used to interrupt dangerous enemy channels.

champions.name: Soraka
champions.title: Champion #134
champions.description: Soraka is a Support lane champion.
strengths: Soraka has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Is Wish off cooldown and do I have an ally anywhere on the map who needs emergency healing? Soraka's global ultimate Wish heals all allies regardless of position. Watch your allies' health bars constantly — a perfectly timed Wish from across the map can save a teammate from a finishing blow. Silence in Equinox is underrated CC — use it on channeling abilities like Katarina R.

champions.name: Swain
champions.title: Champion #135
champions.description: Swain is a Support lane champion.
strengths: Swain has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Have I collected enough soul fragments from pulled enemies to empower my ultimate healing? Swain's Demonic Ascension healing scales with soul fragments collected. Use Vision of Empire and Nevermove to collect fragments from pulled enemies throughout the game. His ultimate is both a damage and survival tool — activate it when below 50% health to heal back up.

champions.name: Sylas
champions.title: Champion #136
champions.description: Sylas is a Mid lane champion.
strengths: Sylas has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Which enemy ultimate is the most game-winning ability to steal right now? Sylas's Hijack copies enemy ultimates — prioritize stealing Orianna ball, Jarvan arena, Miss Fortune bullet time, or Malphite ult. Use stolen ultimates immediately before the enemy uses theirs in a teamfight. Chain E dashes for high mobility gap-closing.

champions.name: Syndra
champions.title: Champion #137
champions.description: Syndra is a Mid lane champion.
strengths: Syndra has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Do I have 6+ orbs on the field for a maximum damage Unleashed Power execute? Syndra deals more damage the more dark spheres are on the field. Use Q and W to generate spheres before fights and never delete them early. Force of Will throwing minions or monsters creates spheres. Save Unleashed Power for squishies when they're near half health.

champions.name: Tahm
champions.title: Champion #138
champions.description: Tahm is a Mid lane champion.
strengths: Tahm has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Should I eat my own ally to save them from death or eat an enemy to remove them from the fight? Tahm Kench's Devour can eat both allies and enemies. Swallow a key ally carry to save them from burst damage, or swallow an enemy tank to remove them from the fight. Never eat a carry to save a support — always prioritize by impact.

champions.name: Taliyah
champions.title: Champion #140
champions.description: Taliyah is a Mid lane champion.
strengths: Taliyah has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Am I using Worked Ground to my advantage by moving to fresh terrain for maximum Threaded Volley damage? Taliyah deals less damage on Worked Ground. Reposition between volleys so you're always firing from fresh stones. Weaver's Wall is one of the most impactful non-combat ultimates in the game — use it to cut off enemy escape routes during objectives.

champions.name: Talon
champions.title: Champion #141
champions.description: Talon is a Mid lane champion.
strengths: Talon has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Have I used wall-jumping Assassin's Path to approach from an angle the enemy isn't watching? Talon can jump almost any wall in the game — use this to roam unpredictably. After winning mid, don't use the river. Jump walls directly to the enemy's sidelane and catch them completely off-guard. Rake W application lets Noxian Diplomacy deal increased damage.

champions.name: Taric
champions.title: Champion #142
champions.description: Taric is a Support lane champion.
strengths: Taric has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Is Cosmic Radiance ultimate timed to make my team invulnerable during the most dangerous moment of the fight? Taric's ultimate gives 2.5 seconds of invulnerability but has a 2.5 second delay. Use it when you see the enemy's full combo coming — activate it early enough so the invulnerability kicks in right as the damage lands.

champions.name: Teemo
champions.title: Champion #143
champions.description: Teemo is a Top lane champion.
strengths: Teemo has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Are my Noxious Traps placed in locations that deny vision and create kill pressure rather than just random spots? Teemo's shrooms are most valuable in dark areas the enemy is forced to walk through — baron and dragon pits, their jungle buffs, and escape routes. A well-shroomed map gives your team complete vision control.

champions.name: Thresh
champions.title: Champion #144
champions.description: Thresh is a Support lane champion.
strengths: Thresh has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Am I using the lantern proactively to position my ADC rather than just reactively to save them? Thresh's Dark Passage lantern can reposition allies as an engage tool, not just for saves. Throw it to an ally behind you during an engage so they dash into the fight. Death Sentence landing is everything — practice hook angles constantly.

champions.name: Tristana
champions.title: Champion #145
champions.description: Tristana is a ADC lane champion.
strengths: Tristana has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Am I stacking Explosive Charge on the right target for maximum detonation damage? Tristana's bomb deals damage based on enemy missing health and stacks from autos and abilities. Place it on the enemy carry, then stack it with autos before detonating. Buster Shot knockback is most valuable to displace a diver off your carry, not just as a damage tool.

champions.name: Trundle
champions.title: Champion #146
champions.description: Trundle is a Top lane champion.
strengths: Trundle has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Is Subjugate stealing enough resistances from the enemy tank to make both of us fight more efficiently? Trundle's ultimate Subjugate steals 40% of the target's armor and magic resist. Use it on the enemy tank to make them squishy and yourself tanky simultaneously. Pillar of Ice is underrated crowd control — use it to block escape routes rather than just slow.

champions.name: Tryndamere
champions.title: Champion #147
champions.description: Tryndamere is a Top lane champion.
strengths: Tryndamere has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Do I have 5 Fury stacks for the Bloodlust heal and is Undying Rage available for the all-in? Tryndamere needs Fury at max before extended fights for maximum healing. Never use Undying Rage at 10% health — use it at 30-40% health to surprise the enemy who expected you to die. Split push with teleport to create pressure the enemy can't ignore.

champions.name: Twisted
champions.title: Champion #148
champions.description: Twisted is a Mid lane champion.
strengths: Twisted has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Which lane is most likely to win a fight if I teleport there with Destiny right now? Twisted Fate's global ultimate reveals all enemies and lets him teleport anywhere. The card pick is your primary mechanics challenge — always pre-pick the gold card before engaging. Destiny is most impactful when used to catch out-of-position carries in sidelanes.

champions.name: Twitch
champions.title: Champion #150
champions.description: Twitch is a ADC lane champion.
strengths: Twitch has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Am I flanking from stealth to position myself behind the enemy team before pressing R? Twitch's Spray and Pray fires in a straight line through all enemies. Position yourself to fire through the maximum number of enemy champions. Always approach from stealth Ambush to get the attack speed bonus and surprise positioning before activating R.

champions.name: Udyr
champions.title: Champion #151
champions.description: Udyr is a Jungle lane champion.
strengths: Udyr has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Which stance does this fight require — Phoenix for AOE, Tiger for single target, Turtle for sustain, or Bear for CC? Udyr cycling stances correctly is the key to his effectiveness. Open with Bear for the stun, switch to Phoenix or Tiger for damage, swap to Turtle when you need healing. Never stay in one stance too long — cycling maximizes his passive.

champions.name: Urgot
champions.title: Champion #152
champions.description: Urgot is a Top lane champion.
strengths: Urgot has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Is the enemy below 25% health in my Disdain execute range for Fear Beyond Death? Urgot's ultimate marks enemies below 25% health for execution. Hook them with Disdain and position your passive legs to proc as many times as possible. He is a lane bully — use Purge Minefield combo to dominate early trades before enemies get resistances.

champions.name: Varus
champions.title: Champion #153
champions.description: Varus is a ADC lane champion.
strengths: Varus has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Have I stacked enough Blight on one target to maximize the burst from one ability? Varus's damage multiplies dramatically with Blight stacks — apply 3 stacks of passive with autos then detonate with E or Q for massive burst. Chain of Corruption ultimate spreads between nearby enemies — aim it at clustered enemies so the roots chain.

champions.name: Vayne
champions.title: Champion #154
champions.description: Vayne is a ADC lane champion.
strengths: Vayne has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Am I using terrain to proc Silver Bolts Condemn wall stun rather than just as a knockback? Vayne's Condemn deals triple damage and stuns when pinning enemies against walls. Always drag fights near walls — position between the enemy and the wall then Condemn at point-blank range. Final Hour stealth with Tumble makes her untargetable while invisible.

champions.name: Veigar
champions.title: Champion #155
champions.description: Veigar is a Mid lane champion.
strengths: Veigar has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Have I collected enough Event Horizon stacks to one-shot the enemy carry with Primordial Burst? Veigar scales to unlimited AP through stacks — every champion ability kill grants bonus AP. Place Event Horizon cage so enemies are stunned at the edges, not the middle. His ultimate deals bonus damage based on enemy AP so prioritize enemy mages.

champions.name: Vel'Koz
champions.title: Champion #156
champions.description: Vel'Koz is a Mid lane champion.
strengths: Vel'Koz has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Am I applying 3 Organic Deconstruction stacks for true damage before using my ultimate? Vel'Koz's passive applies stacks with each ability — three stacks deal true damage. Rotate through Q W and E to stack quickly, then combo with the final true damage proc. Life Form Disintegration Ray deals massive damage to stationary targets — use it on CC'd enemies.

champions.name: Vex
champions.title: Champion #157
champions.description: Vex is a Mid lane champion.
strengths: Vex has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Is my Doom passive fully charged to interrupt a dashing enemy champion with the fear? Vex's passive automatically interrupts dashes with fear when fully charged — it's a powerful counter to mobile champions. Let enemies dash into you rather than chasing them. Personal Space shield can absorb a burst combo if timed right before the damage lands.

champions.name: Vi
champions.title: Champion #158
champions.description: Vi is a Jungle lane champion.
strengths: Vi has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Is Cease and Desist targeting the highest priority enemy carry rather than the most convenient target? Vi's ultimate locks onto one target and suppresses them — always use it on the enemy carry, not the first person in range. Vault Breaker charged Q is a long-range gap-closer — charge it in brush for a surprise engage from unexpected angles.

champions.name: Viego
champions.title: Champion #159
champions.description: Viego is a Jungle lane champion.
strengths: Viego has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Which enemy champion's abilities would be most powerful if I possessed them after killing them? Viego possesses the last enemy champion he killed, gaining all their abilities. Prioritize killing carries or mages whose abilities you can use to chain more kills. His passive mist healing means staying in combat and not retreating when one enemy dies.

champions.name: Viktor
champions.title: Champion #160
champions.description: Viktor is a Mid lane champion.
strengths: Viktor has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Have I upgraded my Hex Core to the appropriate stage for this point in the game? Viktor's upgrades dramatically change his abilities — prioritize Q upgrade for laning, E upgrade for teamfights. Death Ray E combo with W gravity field is his core CC setup. Chaos Storm ultimate follows your cursor so reposition it constantly to maximize damage on the enemy team.

champions.name: Vladimir
champions.title: Champion #161
champions.description: Vladimir is a Mid lane champion.
strengths: Vladimir has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Have I stacked enough Crimson Rush Tides of Blood charges to empower my next ability combo? Vladimir's empowered abilities deal significantly more damage. Pool Sanguine Pool at the perfect moment to dodge crucial CC and become untargetable — it's his only true defensive tool so never waste it on weak poke. He is a late-game scaling monster.

champions.name: Volibear
champions.title: Champion #162
champions.description: Volibear is a Top lane champion.
strengths: Volibear has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Is Stormbringer ultimate positioned to destroy the most impactful tower while disrupting the enemy team? Volibear's ultimate disables nearby towers while active — use it to dive under tower with impunity. Thundering Smash is most impactful when used to pull enemies under your own tower during a gank. His passive lets him survive burst so be aggressive when it procs.

champions.name: Warwick
champions.title: Champion #163
champions.description: Warwick is a Jungle lane champion.
strengths: Warwick has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Is the enemy below 50% health so my Primal Howl scent tracking and movement speed activates? Warwick becomes unrelentingly fast when chasing low-health enemies. Use this to gank lanes where enemies are already damaged — don't gank full-health targets. Infinite Duress suppression dives directly to target so use it on isolated carries.

champions.name: Wukong
champions.title: Champion #164
champions.description: Wukong is a Jungle lane champion.
strengths: Wukong has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Did I use Warrior Trickster to bait out the key enemy ability before committing? Wukong's decoy clone can bait out Malzahar ult, Fiora parry, or Pantheon passive. Use it to test the enemy before fully committing to a fight. Cyclone ultimate during a Zhonya's Hourglass activation is a classic combo.

champions.name: Xayah
champions.title: Champion #165
champions.description: Xayah is a ADC lane champion.
strengths: Xayah has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Have I placed enough feathers on the ground in the right pattern to root multiple enemies with Bladecaller? Xayah's power is in her feather positioning. Fire feathers in a fan pattern during fights, then Bladecaller to pull them all back and root every enemy they pass through. Clean Cuts feathers also block projectiles — position feathers between you and skillshots.

champions.name: Xerath
champions.title: Champion #166
champions.description: Xerath is a Mid lane champion.
strengths: Xerath has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Am I using Rite of the Arcane global ultimate to finish off low-health enemies across the map? Xerath can win fights he never attends via his global ultimate. After winning a fight, use Eye of Destruction and Shocking Orb to secure kills across the map. He is extremely immobile so always stay behind your team at maximum ability range.

champions.name: Xin
champions.title: Champion #167
