champions.description: Xin is a Mid lane champion.
strengths: Xin has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Is Crescent Guard active to knock back enemies outside my ultimate zone during a fight? Xin Zhao's ultimate Crescent Guard knocks all enemies outside his zone away, isolating one target. Use it in combination with diving the enemy carry to separate them from their team's peel. Three Talon Strike slows on the third hit — use it to keep enemies in your ultimate zone.

champions.name: Yasuo
champions.title: Champion #169
champions.description: Yasuo is a Mid lane champion.
strengths: Yasuo has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Is there an ally with a knockup ability who I can coordinate Last Breath with? Yasuo's ultimate requires an airborne enemy — communicate with teammates who have knockups like Malphite, Jarvan, or Alistar. Build flow for Windwall by dashing through minions, then Windwall to block the highest-damage projectile the enemy possesses.

champions.name: Yone
champions.title: Champion #170
champions.description: Yone is a Mid lane champion.
strengths: Yone has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Is Fate Sealed positioned to pull the maximum number of enemies into my team? Yone's ultimate pulls all enemies in its path toward him — position it to drag enemies from the backline into your frontline. Soul Unbound lets you dash forward and return safely — use it aggressively to burst then return to safety before the enemy can react.

champions.name: Yorick
champions.title: Champion #171
champions.description: Yorick is a Top lane champion.
strengths: Yorick has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Is the Maiden of the Mist better deployed to split push a sidelane or fight with me in a teamfight? Yorick is one of the best split pushers in the game — send the Maiden to push a sidelane while you create pressure elsewhere. Mourning Mist slows and marks enemies so all your ghouls target that champion, focusing your army's damage.

champions.name: Yunara
champions.title: Champion #172
champions.description: Yunara is a ADC lane champion.
strengths: Yunara has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Am I using all of Yunara's kit in the right sequence to maximize impact? Focus on learning her ability order and positioning before committing to aggressive plays.

champions.name: Yuumi
champions.title: Champion #173
champions.description: Yuumi is a Support lane champion.
strengths: Yuumi has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Which ally is currently the most fed and mobile that I should attach to for the most impact? Yuumi is strongest attached to a hypercarry who is already winning. Best Friend passive only stacks on the host you spend the most time on — commit to one carry throughout the game. Detach only to heal other allies, then reattach immediately.

champions.name: Zaahen
champions.title: Champion #174
champions.description: Zaahen is a Top lane champion.
strengths: Zaahen has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Is my team in a position to follow up on my engage before I commit? Zaahen excels when the team coordinates around his kit — never engage alone without backup.

champions.name: Zac
champions.title: Champion #175
champions.description: Zac is a Jungle lane champion.
strengths: Zac has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Is Let's Bounce ultimate positioned to knock enemies toward my team rather than away? Zac's ultimate bounces enemies repeatedly — the direction of the final bounce matters most. Position yourself so the last bounce sends enemies into your team. Elastic Slingshot long-range jump is most impactful when used from unexpected angles through walls.

champions.name: Zed
champions.title: Champion #176
champions.description: Zed is a Mid lane champion.
strengths: Zed has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Are all enemy CC abilities on cooldown before I use Death Mark to commit to the kill? Zed dies to one CC ability if he doesn't have his shadow to return to. Throw W shadow, wait for enemy CC to be used on the shadow, then engage with full combo. Living Shadow W positioning determines your escape — always place it where you want to return to.

champions.name: Zeri
champions.title: Champion #177
champions.description: Zeri is a ADC lane champion.
strengths: Zeri has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Am I using Burst Fire Q through terrain to extend its range for unexpected damage? Zeri's Q passes through walls and extends her effective range dramatically. Learn common wall lineups to poke enemies safely through terrain. Lightning Crash ultimate gives her massive movement speed on hits — activate it in fights to become nearly unkiteable.

champions.name: Ziggs
champions.title: Champion #178
champions.description: Ziggs is a Mid lane champion.
strengths: Ziggs has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Am I using Short Fuse passive empowered auto to proc turret damage during sieges? Ziggs's passive empowered auto deals bonus damage to structures — it's one of the fastest tower destroyers in the game. Mega Inferno Bomb can steal Dragon and Baron through walls — always attempt to steal objectives if enemies are low on health.

champions.name: Zilean
champions.title: Champion #179
champions.description: Zilean is a Mid lane champion.
strengths: Zilean has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Is Chronoshift ultimate saved for the right ally at the right moment — the one most likely to be executed? Zilean's ultimate revives one ally — use it on the highest damage dealer in a teamfight when they dive in. Time Bomb double detonation stun is his most reliable CC — place two bombs on the same target to guarantee the stun without needing enemy movement.

champions.name: Zoe
champions.title: Champion #180
champions.description: Zoe is a Mid lane champion.
strengths: Zoe has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Have I picked up a Summoner Spell or item active from a minion for maximum Spell Thief burst? Zoe's Spell Thief passive picks up dropped summoner spells and item actives — Flash and Ignite copies from minions are free burst damage. Portal Jump E is her primary escape tool so never waste it for damage positioning. Sleep duration doubles if enemies move — land Sleepy Trouble Bubble then auto attack to double the sleep.

champions.name: Zyra
champions.title: Champion #181
champions.description: Zyra is a Support lane champion.
strengths: Zyra has strong points in their kit
champions.gameSenseTip: Ask yourself: Are my seeds and plants placed to zone enemies from objectives rather than just dealing damage? Zyra's plants control space around Dragon and Baron more than any other support. Pre-plant seeds in the pit before objectives spawn, then grow them into plants when the fight starts. Stranglethorns ultimate knocks up enemies at the end of its animation — use it as the finishing CC in a combo.
